boundary: Primary full texts and selected official code inspected by delegated researcher; snapshots may postdate papers; no paper experiments reproduced.

sources.title: Concept Induction: Analyzing Unstructured Text with High-Level Concepts Using LLooM

sources.limit: Concept induction and analyst utility do not establish assay-operation equivalence.

sources.adopt: Reuse an evolving schema, discover new entries, reconcile, and remap earlier records.
sources.limit: Dialogue schemas differ from assay contracts; frequency pruning can lose rare valid mechanisms. Embedding-centroid alignment is not a dependable identity oracle.

sources.title: Large Language Models as Oracles for Ontology Alignment
sources.adopt: Apply contextual verification selectively to uncertain candidate correspondences.
sources.limit: Equivalence-only evaluation; precision gains can cost recall; no real human evaluation in the reported comparison.

sources.adopt: Compare nearby candidates together; measure ordering effects and retrieval misses.
sources.limit: At-most-one-match assumption does not transfer to overlapping assay concepts or variable-granularity regions.
